journeys.label: Increment — specified flow

nodes.label: Fresh local page load: Count 0 and explicit Empty explanation; Increment available.
Activate Increment by pointer, or Tab to its native button and use Enter or Space.
Each activation adds exactly 1: three activations show 1, 2, 3; politely announce count and leave Empty state.

failurePaths: A skipped, repeated or double-triggered increment fails REQ-COUNT; fixed tests must check single actions.
Missing focus, announcement, clipped controls, console errors or external requests fail REQ-UI; verification follows implementation.

journeys.label: Reset/reload — specified flow

nodes.label: After incrementing, activate Reset by pointer or native keyboard activation.
Count becomes 0 and Empty explanation returns; Reset at 0 keeps 0; the next Increment shows 1.
Reload the local page: Count starts at 0 because state exists only in page memory.

failurePaths: Retained count after reload or Reset fails REQ-COUNT; do not add storage or persistence.
A hidden Empty explanation, inaccessible Reset or duplicate keyboard action fails acceptance; correct implementation and rerun the unchanged parent tests during verification.

permissions.scope: Specification: Increment and Reset through pointer or native keyboard controls; no accounts or authentication roles.
permissions.enforcedAt: Proposed local browser native controls; not implemented or verified.

permissions.scope: Specification: count in page memory only; fresh load/reload starts at 0. No persistence, accounts, database or API.
permissions.enforcedAt: Proposed src/app.js memory and render function; no storage. This is a specification boundary, not a verified security control.

permissions.scope: Specification: offline local document/assets only; no external requests, remote fonts/assets, vendor integrations or dependencies.
permissions.enforcedAt: Proposed local relative assets with no fetches; later fixed browser tests must verify network behavior.
